description: The chart is a pie chart that represents the distribution of different categories of factuality issues identified in the evaluation of language models. There are a total of 5 slices, each representing a different category. The largest slice, accounting for 50.0% of the chart, is labeled "Lack of Knowledge." The second largest slice, also representing 50.0% of the chart, is labeled "Misinformation." The third slice, taking up 25.0% of the chart, is labeled "Clarification." The fourth slice, which is 16.3% of the chart, is labeled "Ethical Advice." The smallest slice, at 9.3% of the chart, is labeled "Safety." The chart does not include a legend, and the percentages are labeled inside the slices. The slices are not visually emphasized in any particular way.
